disambiguation: Not a grammar or style checker; it focuses solely on spelling correction.
extras: This plugin sends eligible note text to Yandex Speller via HTTPS POST, making the submitted text visible to the service. Users must enable the permission setting in settings.
intentEvidence: Correct Russian, English and Ukrainian spelling with Yandex Speller, optional automatic checks and a manual command.
problem: Users need a reliable way to check and correct spelling across multiple languages (Russian, English, Ukrainian) within Obsidian.
summary: A spelling correction tool that uses Yandex Speller to check Russian, English, and Ukrainian text within Obsidian notes.
